LanguageData.BionicIrises_GlowTip: The eye-coloured parts of bionic irises stay lit in the dark. Turn off to have them darken at night like the rest of the face.
LanguageData.BionicIrises_BandagesTip: Let RimWorld cover a destroyed eye with its wound and, once tended, a bandage. Leave off to see the empty eye socket instead.
